concept.title: Automated Grid Load Monitoring
concept.shortdesc: Automated grid load monitoring continuously tracks substation voltage, transformer capacity, and feeder load to detect anomalies before service disruptions occur.

conbody.p: In enterprise energy management systems, real-time telemetry data is collected from field sensors and Supervisory Control and Data Acquisition (SCADA) endpoints. Operators rely on automated thresholds to identify overload conditions across regional distribution networks.

ul.li: Transformer Load Percentage: Measures active power draw against rated transformer capacity.
Voltage Deviation: Tracks fluctuations outside nominal operating bands (typically ±5%).
Thermal Stress Index: Estimates equipment overheating risk during peak demand windows.

conbody.note: Threshold configurations are evaluated every 30 seconds. Ensure telemetry polling intervals are synchronized across connected substations.
